remarks: Welcome to this stunning and unique 3,068-square-foot home nestled in the desirable Stamford neighborhood. This three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom masterpiece boasts exquisite craftsmanship and high-end touches throughout.  As you step inside, you'll be greeted by radiant heated flooring that adds a touch of luxury to every step. The lighted handrails guide you through the house, creating an elegant and welcoming atmosphere. The beautifully designed bathrooms are a testament to the attention to detail that went into every aspect of this home. Step outside into the serene and picturesque outdoor space. The yard is beautifully landscaped, creating a tranquil oasis. The attractive lighting enhances the ambiance, making it the perfect setting for parties. A pergola provides shade and adds a touch of elegance to the outdoor area.  But the beauty of this home doesn't end there. With riverfront views and a scenic 0.8-mile river walk, you'll be able to enjoy the natural beauty that surrounds the property.
